changelog: App Activity Monitor (Admin Only): Owner Jagadish can now see exactly which applications each team member is running and for how long — Chrome, Brave, VS Code, WhatsApp, Figma, and 40+ more apps tracked in real-time.
Per-User App Breakdown: Full detail panel per team member showing app name, total time used, % of workday bar, and last active timestamp — all with live auto-refresh.
Fleet KPIs: Dashboard cards for Active Users Tracked, Distinct Apps Today, Total App Hours Today, and Most Used App across the entire team.
Date History View: Browse any past date to see historical app usage for each team member.
Reliable App Detection: Uses native tasklist CSV scanner for accurate cross-app detection — Chrome, VS Code, WhatsApp, Antigravity IDE, Brave, Figma, Discord, Teams, and more.
Strict Owner-Only Access: App Monitor tab is completely hidden for all non-admin users. Only jagadish2k2006@gmail.com can access it.
Background Silent Sync: All users silently sync their own usage to cloud every 60 seconds — data is visible only to the owner.
Fix: Resolved JavaScript function hoisting recursion bug in updateAuthUI that caused Maximum call stack size exceeded on auth.
